description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the VacancyDao class in the recruitment module of the OrangeHRM system. It tests CRUD operations and retrieval methods related to recruitment vacancy data.

classes.name: VacancyDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the VacancyDao data access object related to recruitment vacancies in OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creating a VacancyDao instance and populating test fixtures.

methods.name: testSaveVacancy
methods.description: Tests saving a new Vacancy entity and verifies it's correctly persisted.

methods.name: testGetVacancyById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a Vacancy by ID and validates retrieved data.

methods.name: testUpdateVacancy
methods.description: Tests updating an existing Vacancy and verifies changes are saved.

methods.name: testDeleteVacancies
methods.description: Tests deleting Vacancy records by IDs.

methods.name: testGetVacancies
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of Vacancies with default filters.

methods.name: testGetVacanciesFilterByJobTitle
methods.description: Tests filtering Vacancies by job title ID.

methods.name: testGetVacanciesFilterByVacancyId
methods.description: Tests filtering Vacancies by specific vacancy IDs.

methods.name: testGetVacanciesFilterByHiringMangerId
methods.description: Tests filtering Vacancies by hiring manager’s employee number.

methods.name: testGetVacancyListGroupByHiringManager
methods.description: Tests retrieving vacancy list grouped by hiring manager.

methods.name: testSearchVacanciesCount
methods.description: Tests counting the total number of Vacancies matching search criteria.
